events.name: Sip and Paint with ArtwithAubrey
events.description:
Forget blank canvases and pressure — this is sip-and-paint season, Azúcar style. Pull up a seat in the Ranchero Room while Art With Aubrey walks you through decorating your very own set of Christmas bulbs, one sip and one brushstroke at a time. No art degree required, just a little holiday chispa and a drink in hand.

Aubrey's got the instruction and inspiration covered, so whether you're painting a tiny masterpiece or something delightfully chaotic, you'll leave with ornaments nobody else has and a tree that actually looks like you. Glitter, color, a little sparkle in your glass — it's festive, it's forgiving, and it's made for laughing at your own art.

Come solo, bring your people, make it a date night — every bulb, every brushstroke, every body welcome. December 6th at 6pm, Ranchero Room. Come paint, sip, and deck your tree the Azúcar way.

🗓️ Domingo 6 de diciembre — Show 6:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $33

events.name: Magic Hunks
events.description:
Las Vegas' world-famous stage show lands en Pasco, y trust us — the Ranchero Room was built for this kind of fuego. Magic Hunk Jacob headlines a night of world-class choreography, heart-pounding música, and crowd interaction that pulls you straight into the action — no spectators here, mamas, solo participants. Bring the birthday girl, the bachelorette crew, the recently-divorced-and-thriving squad, or just the girls who need a Friday to let loose.

Doors open 8:30PM, showtime hits 9PM sharp — get there con tiempo, because front-row seats and VIP tables desaparecen rápido. VIP admission gets you reserved seating up close y personal, plus a post-show Meet & Greet photo session with the cast — because some memories need proof.

Expect copas flowing, energy altísima, and a room full of mujeres ready to scream, dance, and blush a little. This is The Best Girls Night Ever, Azúcar-style — sensual, wild, unforgettable.

21+ con ID válida. Tag tu crew, lock your tickets, y nos vemos en el Ranchero Room.

🗓️ Viernes 19 de febrero — Show 9:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $20-$60

🎟️ Tickets: https://avenueticket.com/event/pasco
